text: run_backcalc() function fits CD4-staged back-calculation model using cmdstanr. default, chain runs 1000 warmup 1000 sampling iterations across 4 chains. faster iteration development, can reduce number iterations chains:
code: hiv_list <- run_backcalc(sim_diags) hiv_list <- run_backcalc(   sim_diags,   iter_warmup = 500,   iter_sampling = 500,   chains = 2 )
